name: M3_PMS100MI_LstByRORN
description: Retrieve manufacturing orders linked to a specific reference order. This operation searches for manufacturing orders using a combination of reference order category, reference order number, reference order line, and optionally line suffix. The reference order can be, for example, a manufacturing, purchase, customer, distribution, work, service, or project order, depending on the reference order category. The result lists one or more matching manufacturing orders together with their product number and facility, while also echoing the reference order identifiers. Use this to navigate from an originating order line to the manufacturing order(s) that fulfill it.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Reference order category indicating the type of reference order used to select manufacturing orders, such as customer or purchase order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number used to select manufacturing orders linked to that order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Reference order line number used to narrow the selection of manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to restrict the search to manufacturing orders in a specific company.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Reference order line suffix used to further specify the sub-line when selecting manufacturing orders.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Reference order category linked to the manufacturing order, indicating the type of reference order such as customer or purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Reference order line number linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Suffix distinguishing sub-lines on the reference order line linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.
